newsitem.title: USA: BPA sets AC Intertie maintenance through Feb 7.
newsitem.headline: BPA sets AC Intertie maintenance through Feb 7.

text.p: Power flows on the AC segment of the Pacific Intertie will be reduced Feb 6-7 as well as Feb 1-5, a Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) spokeswoman said Thursday.

BPA previously said maintenance work would limit southbound flows to 2,800 megawatts (MW) and northbound flows to 2,550 MW between 1200 and 1730 PDT on Feb 3 and between 0800 and 1730 PDT on Feb 4 and 5.
A BPA spokeswoman said Thursday the same cuts will also be made on Feb 6 and 7 between 0730 and 1730 PDT.
As previously reported, southbound transmissions on Feb 1 will be limited to 2,000 MW, compared with a usual rate of 3,200 MW between hours ending 0800-1600 PDT.
During the same hours, northbound transmissions will be restricted to 3,200 MW, compared with 3,675 MW currently.
